camera.label: Camera
camera.description: Neutral camera pose. Mapped to the underlying host's framing + zoom.

worldWidth.label: World Width
worldWidth.description: Side/free world bounds (2D `side`) and 3D world extent.

drawables.label: Drawables
drawables.description: Neutral drawable descriptors — the `draw-*` children. Routed to the host's painter.

lighting.label: Lighting
lighting.description: 3D scene light rig as data — ambient/directional/hemisphere/point lights + optional 'room' environment for PBR reflections. Omitted → the standard fixed rig.

tileClickEvent.label: Tile Click Event
tileClickEvent.description: --- Shared interaction (LOLO-owned). The painter emitted at runtime depends on

children.label: Children
children.description: Declarative JSX drawable children (`<DrawShape .../>` composed in paint order). Forwarded to the 2D host, which collects them via drawable registry context.

projection.label: Projection
projection.description: 2D grid layout (2D mode only): isometric / hex / flat / free / side.

fit.label: Fit
fit.description: Auto-fit the board's grid extent to the viewport (2D grid layouts; default false — boards render at their authored `camera.zoom` scale).

tileWidth.label: Tile Width
tileWidth.description: Native tile/cell width in source px of the board's asset (2D grid layouts; defaults to the detected atlas tile width, else 256).

post.label: Post
post.description: 3D post-processing stack — bloom (emissive glow / neon) and vignette. Omitted → no post pass.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Painter: 2D sprite/shape/text raster, or 3D mesh. Default '2d'.

backgroundColor.label: Background Color
backgroundColor.description: Solid backdrop colour — 2D `side` fill and 3D scene clear colour.
